page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9a.4xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on KVM hypervisor technology and the x86_64 architecture. Powered by a 2.7 GHz AMD EPYC 9T25 processor, this server provides 16 dedicated vCPUs alongside 32.0 GB of system memory. This configuration establishes a compute-focused ratio of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU, targeting workloads that require substantial processing capacity relative to memory capacity.

The instance features a baseline network throughput of 12 Gbps and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Local ephemeral storage is not included on the instance, necessitating external network-attached block storage for persistent data requirements. Additionally, the instance contains no dedicated hardware accelerators or GPUs.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the compute-dense allocation of 2.0 GB RAM per vCPU provides an efficient allocation model for CPU-bound tasks, avoiding expenses associated with unneeded memory overhead. Tradeoffs include the dependency on external block storage for persistent I/O and a lack of GPU hardware acceleration. The ecs.c9a.4xlarge is suitable for batch processing, CI/CD build servers, web application serving, and high-concurrency microservices.
